items.title: TORchIM 0.1.4.161 Alpha
items.body: This release updates the bundled Tor client to 0.4.9.12, which addresses a series of high-severity security issues reported by the Tor Project. Updating is strongly recommended. Portable Windows x64 builds were manually tested on Windows 10 and Windows 11.

items.title: TORchIM 0.1.4.51 Alpha
items.body: IMPORTANT: PROTOCOL COMPATIBILITY. The incompatibility is intentional and limited to the peer transport protocol. The protocol was hardened after v0.1.4.36 with signed Ed25519 session identity binding, and v0.1.4.51 rejects legacy unsigned handshakes fail-closed.

items.title: TORchIM 0.1.3.25 Alpha
items.body: A new Windows alpha build is available on GitHub. It adds contact tags and folders, host-relayed Temporary Groups, invitation and member-state improvements, stable sidebar ordering, and related UI and localization fixes.

items.title: Project News Feed Upgrade
items.body: The welcome screen news block now supports cached project news, manual refresh, offline fallback, and an expanded All news view. New updates can be published by adding a news item to the top of this file.

items.title: P2P Message Delivery Queue
items.body: Message delivery was improved by keeping queued text as plaintext until a ready encrypted transport session is available. This reduces reconnect and session-key race issues during Tor warm-up.

items.title: CSS and UI Polishing
items.body: Recent theme work cleaned up chat input colors, sidebar spacing, and small visual inconsistencies across the desktop interface.

items.title: Help, Options and News
items.body: TORchIM is getting a help screen, options tab and safer project news feed.

items.title: Message Queue Fixes
items.body: Queued message handling was tightened so pending messages are retried more predictably after reconnects and slow Tor onion availability.

items.title: Contact List Reliability
items.body: Contact list rendering and unread message indicators were improved, including fixes for empty contact cells and notification badges in the sidebar.
